candidates.title: Dependency-Guided Parallel Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
candidates.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) accelerate text generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel. However, parallel decoding introduces a distributional mismatch: it approximates the joint conditional using a fully factorized product of per-token marginals, which degrades output quality when selected tokens are strongly dependent. We propose DEMASK (DEpendency-guided unMASKing), a lightweight dependency predictor that attaches to the final hidden states of a dLLM. In a single forward pass, it estimates pairwise conditional influences between masked positions. Using these predictions, a greedy selection algorithm identifies positions with bounded cumulative dependency for simultaneous unmasking. Under a sub-additivity assumption, we prove this bounds the total variation distance between our parallel sampling and the model's joint. Empirically, DEMASK achieves 1.7-2.2$\times$ speedup on Dream-7B while matching or improving accuracy compared to confidence-based and KL-based baselines.
candidates.reason: DEMASKはmasked位置間の条件依存を予測し、累積依存閾値を満たす集合を同時unmaskする。外部AR検証やKV管理ではなくdiffusion生成状態の並列更新を制御する。

lineage_proposal.title: Diffusion Language Model Decoding Efficiency
lineage_proposal.description: 離散・masked diffusion言語モデルの生成token commit順序・並列幅、denoising回数、単一request内のrefinement/advancement依存、候補軌道の分岐・剪定・計算配分を制御し、NFEやlatency/throughputと品質の関係を改善する研究をまとめる。
lineage_proposal.distinctness_reason: The common optimization unit is the diffusion generation trajectory: choosing masked-token updates, denoising rounds, per-request generation/refinement lanes, or candidate trajectories and budgets. The reviewed papers report denoising/NFE, throughput, or quality-efficiency outcomes. This differs from ordinary autoregressive layer/token pruning, target-model-verified speculative decoding, KV storage/update, kernel generation, and cross-request serving.
lineage_proposal.boundary_rule: Include inference-time methods whose primary mechanism schedules, selects, branches, prunes, or verifies denoising states or token commitments within a discrete/masked diffusion-LM request, with direct evidence on denoising rounds/NFE, latency/throughput, or quality-efficiency. Include per-request lane scheduling only when it changes diffusion refinement/advancement dependency. Exclude new model/backbone architecture or training-only gains; general conditional layer/token skipping independent of the diffusion denoising process; external target-model draft verification (05); primary KV/cache management (07); primary kernel/runtime work (09); cross-request admission/batching/resource scheduling (11); sparse query-key computation (13); and methods whose primary evidence shows quality gains without inference-efficiency evidence.
scope_includes: masked位置のunmask/commit順序と同時更新幅の制御
denoising round/NFE予算の適応的配分
diffusion refinement/advancementを分離する単一request内の依存制御
denoising軌道の探索・remask・剪定による品質対計算量改善
scope_excludes: 一般model/backbone設計、training-only、効率評価のない品質改善
通常の入力token/layer skipping04、外部target-modelによるdraft verification05
主貢献がKV/cache07またはkernel/runtime09の研究

candidates.library_body_check: 一次本文v1 §4.1–4.3、§5.1–5.4、§7確認。Dream-7B/4benchmark、8H200 data parallel batch1/GPUでwall-clock比較。保証はsubadditivityと真の依存を仮定し、実装は学習近似。別backboneへの一般化未検証。
